### The Unwanted Touch at the Bar
More drinks flow at the pub as the group enjoys the evening like family. Benjamin rises to order the penultimate round, feeling the alcohol; Scarlett rises with him to help carry drinks. At the bar, visibly inebriated CJ (Christian, Benjamin's cousin) appears, offers to buy the round as guest of honour. Benjamin politely declines. CJ, blocking with his body, lifts Scarlett's sage-green sundress slightly and places his hand on her bare behind without Benjamin seeing. [msg_212]

Scarlett feels the exact moment: warm, bold, uninvited palm on the curve of her behind, Guinness breath, dark eyes with alcohol-loosened confidence. Her body tenses instinctively but she does not flinch or gasp. She turns with calm, unflinching steel (carried since age nineteen when she learned the world could turn violent), red hair shifting, Star of Ishtar tattoo catching light. She grips his wrist firmly with her free hand (the other laced with Benjamin's), voice low velvet-soft but edged with dangerous calm and Swedish lilt: “Christian, That’s enough. I’m here with Ben. Very happily here with Ben. Let’s keep the evening about family, shall we? No need to make it anything else.” She lifts his hand away deliberately, places it on the bar, nails lingering firmly but not painfully, then turns fully to Benjamin, pressing close, hand on his lower back under shirt, whispering in Swedish: “Han försökte… men det spelade ingen roll. Jag hanterade det, älskling. Jag är din. Bara din. Och jag är så stolt över att vara det.” She kisses his neck slowly, stays tucked against his side with quiet strength. Drinks ready, she helps carry, private proud smile: “Ready to go back to the table, min värld?” No one gets to ruin this night. [msg_213]

Emotional/relational texture: Scarlett's long-honed calm de-escalation and protective steel surface immediately; she refuses to let the violation escalate or ruin the family night, channels it into deeper closeness with Benjamin, affirming “I am yours. Only yours.” Benjamin's attention is on ordering but he registers the shift. The bond tightens through the quiet crisis; Scarlett's vulnerability (unwanted touch) met with her own agency and love for Benjamin. Intimacy shift: physical press, Swedish whisper, neck kiss, hand under shirt — private claiming amid public setting.
